energy_perspective: Acute antivirals (acyclovir, oseltamivir) = acute Heat reduction в viral-specific tissues
HIV antiretrovirals = chronic Yang preservation (preventing immune depletion = preventing M-D drift)
HCV DAAs = curative — removes chronic Heat-Damp pattern в liver
HBV antivirals = chronic suppression — prevents M-D progression в liver
class_warnings: Acyclovir/valacyclovir: renal toxicity especially dehydrated; CNS effects в severe renal impairment
Oseltamivir: neuropsychiatric AE (especially adolescents); modest efficacy; 48h window critical
TDF/FTC: HBV reactivation if stopped; TDF renal/bone toxicity long-term; TAF preferred newer
HCV DAAs: HBV reactivation в coinfection
obs_mark_to_fill: Influenza antiviral prescribing (high-risk only vs broader)
HCV DAA era impact on practice
KCTS screening в chronic viral infection patients

logic_review_flags_for_mark._note: Источник добавил 'Logic Review Flag' секцию с framework-вопросами для Mark — перенесены как research questions, без изменения governance.
logic_review_flags_for_mark.issue_1_hcv_curative: [RF] HCV DAA назван 'curative — complete removal of chronic disease pattern' — первый класс в БД, полностью устраняющий chronic disease (vs suppressing). Q for Mark: правильное framework application? Caveat: фиброз может persist (M-S patterns в liver) даже после virus clearance.
logic_review_flags_for_mark.issue_2_hiv_art_yang: [RF] ART как 'sustained Yang preservation через immune protection' — logical но novel; targeted molecular therapies обычно не framed energetically. Q: acceptable extension или slow down energy attribution?
logic_review_flags_for_mark.issue_3_kcts_chronic_viral: [RF] AIRE-triggers связаны с chronic viral infections через social/lifestyle markers — НЕ было explicitly в Module 05 Hamer canon для этих conditions. Q: OK extend KCTS к chronic viral populations, или speculative? [GOVERNANCE: в любом случае — research-only, не клинически.]
logic_review_flags_for_mark.issue_4_hbv_coverage: [RF] HBV coverage thin (TDF/FTC primarily HIV-framed). Q: расширить отдельной HBV-секцией?

mechanism_primary: [LBL] Selective activation by viral thymidine kinase → acyclovir triphosphate
[LBL] Incorporates в viral DNA → chain termination
[LBL] Selective — minimal toxicity к human cells

dosing.dose: HSV genital first episode 400 mg TID × 7-10d; HSV recurrent 800 mg BID × 5d; Suppressive HSV 400 mg BID; VZV/shingles 800 mg 5x/day × 7d; HSV encephalitis IV 10 mg/kg q8h × 14-21d

constitutional.energy: Acute Heat reduction in viral-affected tissue (mucocutaneous, neural); translation: selective HSV/VZV DNA polymerase inhibition

membrane.impact: Acute use clearing infection → supports return к M-0; chronic suppressive well-tolerated long-term

phase.match: Acute Phase 2 (HSV outbreak inflammation); chronic suppressive prevents recurrent Phase 2 events

ddi_critical_1_star: [LBL] Other nephrotoxic drugs — additive AKI risk
pregnancy: [LBL] Category B — generally safe (extensive use data)

serious: [LBL] CNS toxicity в renal impairment — confusion, hallucinations, encephalopathy

mark_observations.acyclovir_suppressive_therapy: [OBS-Mark] [Mark, suppressive therapy indications в genital HSV?]

mechanism_primary: [LBL] Better oral bioavailability (~55% vs 15-30% acyclovir) — converted to acyclovir в gut wall и liver

dosing.dose: HSV genital first episode 1 g BID × 7-10d; HSV recurrent 500 mg BID × 3d; Suppressive 500-1000 mg daily; Herpes labialis 2 g × 2 doses 12h apart (1-day); VZV/shingles 1 g TID × 7d

constitutional.energy: Acute Heat reduction (acyclovir prodrug); better bioavailability

distinct: [LBL] Thrombotic microangiopathy — rare but documented в high-dose use (especially HIV CD4 <100)
[LBL] Otherwise similar к acyclovir safety profile

mechanism_primary: [LBL] Blocks viral neuraminidase → prevents viral release from infected cells → reduces spread

approved: [LBL] Influenza A и B treatment (start within 48h symptoms)

dosing.dose: Treatment 75 mg BID × 5d; Prophylaxis 75 mg daily × 7-10d post-exposure; Pediatric weight-based

constitutional.energy: Acute Heat reduction в viral respiratory infection; translation: neuraminidase blockade
caution: Yin-Wood frail elderly с CNS sensitivity (rare neuropsychiatric AE)

membrane.impact: Acute use, short course, minimal long-term

phase.match: Acute Phase 1/2 viral illness; modest reduction в symptom duration (~1 day); more benefit if started early (<24h)

clinical_reality_check: [GL] Symptom duration reduction ~17 hours average (Cochrane analysis)
[GL] Cost-benefit debated; critics argue overhyped; defenders argue benefit в high-risk + early use

serious: [LBL] Neuropsychiatric events — rare; particularly children/adolescents (FDA warning Japan)

mark_observations.oseltamivir_prescribing: [OBS-Mark] [Oseltamivir prescribing — high-risk vs broad use approach?]

mechanism_primary: [LBL] Inhibits HIV reverse transcriptase + HBV polymerase
formulations: TAF (tenofovir alafenamide) — newer, less renal/bone toxicity

constitutional.energy: Sustained Yang preservation through immune protection (HIV) or chronic Heat-Damp suppression в liver (HBV); translation: reverse transcriptase / DNA polymerase inhibition. [RF — see logic_review_flag issue_2: novel energetic framing of targeted therapy]

membrane.impact: TDF causes mild M-D drift в bone и kidney over years; TAF safer; untreated HIV: progressive immune depletion = M-D2 → M-D3 trajectory; ART prevents this

phase.match: Chronic suppression therapy; lifetime (HIV) or long-term (HBV)

critical: [LBL] HBV reactivation if HBV-coinfected patient stops therapy — severe hepatitis
[LBL] TDF: renal toxicity (Fanconi-like), bone mineral density reduction — monitor eGFR, phosphate, urine protein
[LBL] TAF: less renal/bone toxicity, slight weight gain signal, preferred в most current regimens
[LBL] CYP minimal — fewer DDIs than other ART classes

kcts_awareness_rf._note: [RF] Источник: пациенты с chronic HCV много лет часто имеют AIRE-trigger markers (stigma + social isolation, treatment-refractory pre-DAA, single carriers, IVDU history с trauma). Источник предлагает 'KCTS resolution приоритет ДО DAA treatment в complex psychosocial cases'.
kcts_awareness_rf._governance: [GOVERNANCE] Это research-гипотеза. HCV DAA — куративная, time-sensitive evidence-based терапия; 'KCTS resolution' НЕ является prerequisite и НЕ должна откладывать DAA. Standard-care primacy. Не операционализировано, не patient-facing.
